announcements.headline: Cancellation - Intuitive Investments Group plc
announcements.insight: Following the August court sanction, shares are now suspended as the scheme becomes effective. This marks the conclusion of the takeover process for shareholders.

announcements.headline: Scheme Effective
announcements.insight: The scheme is now effective following court sanction in August. Shares are suspended pending completion of the transaction.

announcements.headline: Suspension - Intuitive Investments Group plc
announcements.insight: Intuitive Investments Group plc shares are suspended following court sanction of the scheme in August. Shareholders should monitor for further updates regarding the completion of the transaction.

announcements.headline: Court Sanction of the Scheme
announcements.insight: Following the July Scheme Document and August meeting results, this court sanction finalizes the scheme. Shareholders should monitor for the effective date and consideration receipt.

announcements.headline: Results of the Court Meeting and General Meeting
announcements.insight: Following the July scheme document, this filing reports the outcome of the court meeting. Shareholders must await the next step in the transaction process.

announcements.headline: Exercise of Warrants, Issue of Equity
Publication and posting of Scheme Document
announcements.insight: Following the June deadline extension, this scheme document advances the formal takeover process. Shareholders should monitor the subsequent court meeting and sanction steps.

announcements.headline: Issue of Equity, Amendment to Warrants
Further Extension of PUSU Deadline
announcements.insight: Intuitive Investments Group extends a deadline, indicating ongoing process activity. Shareholders should monitor for subsequent steps in this sequence.
